name: std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<T>::polymorphic_allocator
intro:
Constructs a new polymorphic_allocator.

1) Constructs a polymorphic_allocator using the return value of std::pmr::get_default_resource() as the underlying memory resource.

2,3) Constructs a polymorphic_allocator using other.resource() as the underlying memory resource.

4) Constructs a polymorphic_allocator using r as the underlying memory resource. This constructor provides an implicit conversion from std::pmr::memory_resource*.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

 another polymorphic_allocator to copy from


 r

 -

 pointer to the memory resource to use. May not be null

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Copying a container using a polymorphic_allocator will not call the allocator's copy constructor. Instead, the new container will use the return value of select_on_container_copy_construction (a default-constructed polymorphic_allocator) as its allocator.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Allocate, construct, destroy, and release storage. Public allocate/deallocate/is_equal dispatch to each resource's protected do_* implementation.
